notes:
A compound of カニ (crab) and {蒲鉾|かまぼこ} (fish cake). Made from surimi (processed fish paste) that is shaped, colored, and flavored to resemble crab leg meat. A Japanese food invention from the 1970s that has become popular worldwide.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カニカマボコ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧: imitation crab salad
- カニカマボコ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: imitation crab tempura
- カニカマボコ{入|い}り: containing imitation crab

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カニカマ→カニカマ：10793_kanikama⟧: imitation crab (common abbreviation)
- {蒲鉾|かまぼこ}: fish cake (the base product)
- ⟦すり{身|み}→すり身：08774_surimi⟧: surimi (the raw fish paste material)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Invented in Japan in 1972, カニカマボコ (usually called ⟦カニカマ→カニカマ：10793_kanikama⟧) is one of Japan's most successful food exports. It is made from white fish such as {鱈|たら} (cod) and is valued for being high in protein, low in fat, and affordable. In Japan, it is a staple ingredient in ⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧, salads, and ⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧.
